description: Source code implementing whitespace rules handling for a Git-related project, including parsing, checking, and fixing whitespace issues in lines.

classes.name: struct whitespace_rule
classes.description: Defines a whitespace rule with name, bitmask, and flags for error loosening and default exclusion.

methods.name: parse_whitespace_rule
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a whitespace rule bitmask, handling negation and tab width settings.

methods.name: whitespace_rule
methods.description: Determines the whitespace rule for a given file path based on attributes and configuration.

methods.name: whitespace_error_string
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing whitespace errors based on a bitmask.

methods.name: ws_check_emit_1
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues, optionally emitting highlighted output.

methods.name: ws_check_emit
methods.description: Wrapper around ws_check_emit_1, ignoring the output.

methods.name: ws_check
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues, returning a bitmask.

methods.name: ws_blank_line
methods.description: Determines if a line is blank (only whitespace).

methods.name: ws_fix_copy
methods.description: Copies a line into a buffer, fixing whitespace according to rules, and optionally counts errors.
